text: DSH Session Rerun 是面向 DSH Web 的会话界面插件，会在对话视图中加入可展开的 Turn 和 Step 时间线，呈现输入、回复、工具调用、技能、状态、耗时和相关文件名。用户可以查看某个已完成步骤，并触发在新会话中重放；客户端会等待新会话出现在列表后将其打开。适合需要检查并重新运行先前会话步骤的 DSH 用户。无需额外密钥或账号。

DSH Session Rerun adds a Turn and Step timeline to DSH Web, showing messages, tools, skills, statuses, durations, and referenced files. Select a completed step to create a replay in a new session; the client opens it when available. Useful for reviewing and rerunning earlier work.
想查看 DSH 会话里每一轮和每一步发生了什么。
能不能把之前完成的某个步骤重新跑一遍，并保留原会话？
I want to inspect a past DSH step and replay it in a fresh session.
DSH Session Rerun 的功能「按步骤查看会话」：在对话界面按 Turn 和 Step 展开会话时间线，并查看工具、技能、状态、耗时和文件引用等摘要。展开步骤可查看活动内容；视图还提供加载更早会话内容的入口。
DSH Session Rerun 的功能「重放已完成步骤」：点击步骤的播放操作，按 Turn 和 Step 创建重放会话；会话出现后客户端自动打开。

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · DSH Session Rerun：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

`dsh-session-rerun` is an installable [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin for inspecting and replaying a completed session Step.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Features：- Groups the durable session timeline by Turn and Step.
- Shows model replies, tool calls, Skills, failures, and elapsed time.
- Displays referenced script and Markdown filenames as compact badges on the right side of each Step.
- Replays a top-level Step in a new session without changing the source session.
- Replays a selected Subagent Step through a new main session in the original workspace. The new main Agent keeps only the recreated delegation, waits for the new child, and continues from that child's result.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · From npm (recommended)：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add \
  dsh-client-ui-session-rerun \
  --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

For DSH Desktop, use the same package with the Desktop profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  dsh-client-ui-session-rerun \
  --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · From GitHub：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add \
  github:liuyangdongdong/dsh-session-rerun
```

Replace `--profile web` with `--profile desktop` to install the GitHub build in DSH Desktop.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Start Web：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Restart an already running Web process after installing or replacing the plugin.
dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Behavior：The plugin never mutates the source session. A successful replay creates a new main session in the source workspace and opens it in the Web UI.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Behavior：For a normal Step, the new Agent receives the durable history before the selected Step and that Step's logged user input. For a Subagent Step, the plugin creates a new main session and a new child session. The child replays the selected Step, while the new main session reconstructs only the delegation call, waits for the child, receives the new child result, and then continues.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Behavior：Nested Subagent replay is intentionally unsupported. A Step must exist and have a matching `step/end` event before it can be replayed.

See [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) for the package split and lifecycle.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Packages：| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `dsh-client-ui-session-rerun` | Installable Web bundle, timeline projection, replay controls, and file badges |
| `dsh-session-rerun` | Host Remote that reads durable sessions and creates replay sessions |

The root package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`; `cordis.patch.yml` mounts both roles. This follows the Harness profile and bundle model without modifying `agent-loop`.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Development：Requirements: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and pnpm `11.7.0`.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm pack:check

The committed `lib/` artifacts make npm and GitHub installations executable without an install-time build. The Web client artifact uses the DeepSeek Harness module-loader bundle format; regenerate it with a compatible Harness checkout after changing browser source.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Development：The client accepts both the split conversation registries used by current Web profiles and the combined `uiConversation` service used by DSH Desktop 2.0.4.

dsh-client-ui-session-rerun README · Development：The standalone CI checks the distributable bundle, package exports, Cordis patch, and pure timeline projection. The complete Host, browser registration, event-assembler, and React integration suites remain in `packages/host/tests` and `tests`; they run in a compatible DeepSeek Harness source checkout, where the source-plane module table is available.

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview, so peer dependency versions may need to move with upstream releases.
